newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police arrest suspected Sicilian mafia boss.
newsitem.headline: French police arrest suspected Sicilian mafia boss.

text.p: French police have arrested a suspected leader of the Sicilian Mafia active in the drugs trade, police said on Tuesday.
They said Francesco Paolo Albamonte, 40, was detained in the southern France port of Toulon on Monday thanks to a tip-off from Italy's paramilitary carabinieri police.
He did not put up resistance and could be extradited soon to Italy, police said.
According to an international arrest warrant, Albamonte was sought for alleged involvement in an international cocaine smuggling ring dismantled in Britain several months ago.
The warrant identified him as a suspected deputy to Mafia "boss of bosses" Salvatore "The Beast" Riina, who was captured in Palermo in 1993.
